title: Prepare for Major Updates with Preview Environments

facts.text: Preview environments are sandbox environments created on or updated to a preview version of Business Central.
Public preview runs in March and September before major updates, with environments deleted 30 days after GA.
Early access preview coincides with update period; only Partner Sandbox license tenants can participate.
Early access preview environments auto-update every Sunday to latest build; failed updates result in auto-deletion.
During early access preview, environments can only transfer to another tenant with Partner Sandbox license.
Preview environments cannot be updated to a different version; data must be exported before preview period ends.
Sandbox copies of production enable testing new functionality with existing data, setup, and customizations.
Testing extensions in preview sandbox verifies compatibility and functionality before major version release.
